title: parathelypteris japonica var. musashiensis
intro: Parathelypteris japonica var. musashiensis, commonly known as Japanese fern, is a variety of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Japanese fern include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Japanese fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
